image.alt: A drawing of storage bins at Mehrgarh from above: two rows of square brick compartments divided by partition walls.

zebu.alt: A humped zebu bull, the Indian cattle breed raised at Neolithic Mehrgarh, standing in profile against dry scrubland.

beads.alt: Small Neolithic ornaments laid on a neutral surface: deep-blue lapis lazuli beads, orange-red carnelian beads, and cut shell pieces, some drilled for stringing.
